sources.title: aiconjured/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-MTP-GGUF-Q8-NVFP4
sources.snippet: What is this? The HauhauCS Aggressive release is a 27B dense causal language model with a vision encoder: direct answers, no refusal behavior, minimal preamble on hard prompts (0/465 refusals). It preserves Qwen3.8's native NextN (MTP) head and offers the HauhauCS FastMTP acceleration sidecar. This NVFP4 mixed re-quant keeps all of that intact and makes the model fit comfortably on a 24 GB ...
